fields.System.Title: INT-303 — Daily stock snapshot
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a finance team member, I want a record of what we held at the end of each day, so
that month-end reporting does not mean replaying the entire movement ledger.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a nightly job, then it records on-hand, reserved, and in-transit per product per
  • warehouse as at a defined cut-off time.
  • - Given a past date, then the snapshot for it can be queried directly.
  • - Given a snapshot, then it is immutable once written.
  • - Given a missed run, then the gap is detected and the snapshot can be regenerated from
  • the ledger for that date.
  • - Given the cut-off time, then it is expressed in the warehouse timezone and recorded on
  • the snapshot.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inventory |
| Tables | stock_snapshot_daily, stock_movement |
| Risks | Timezone ambiguity on the cut-off ([doc 09 §9.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); missed runs unnoticed |
| Tests | integration |
